video.caption: Recorded from Zentro running locally: Alex starts a call, Sam opens the same link and joins, both video tiles go live, and they chat. The cameras are Chrome’s built-in test feed, because this was recorded headless.

shots.alt: Zentro landing page: The call is the whole product, with a Start a call button and a field to join with a code
The lobby before joining: a live camera preview, mic and camera toggles, the name Alex, and Enter meeting with a copyable invite link
A call with two people connected: Sam in the main tile, Alex in picture-in-picture, and the call controls along the bottom

note: Media captured from the app running locally; camera feeds are Chrome’s synthetic test pattern.
